## Musk Tesla Pay Package Valued at $158 Billion — 2.5 Million Times Median Worker Compensation

The disclosure extends governance scrutiny of TSLA's board independence; no direct impact on the EV or AI thesis but sustains headline overhang that can pressure institutional holders with ESG or proxy-voting mandates.

- Disclosed Tesla CEO compensation was $158 billion in 2025, per headlines.
- Pay ratio stood at 2.5 million times median worker salary — one of the highest ever disclosed publicly.
- A second headline references comparison to an EV competitor, but that headline is truncated; no specific rival figure confirmed.
- Story is governance/disclosure-driven with no new product or financial performance signal.
